READ-ONLY design-consistency audit of the Nxeon MARKETING website at /opt/nxeon. Do NOT edit/build/mutate — catalog only.

The owner says the site was built page-by-page over time, so sections look inconsistent. The TWO best pages are the GOLD STANDARD: the homepage `app/page.tsx` (+ components/marketing/*) and the new pricing page `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx` + `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. Goal: everything should look like it belongs to the same premium site as those two.

Read the gold-standard pages first to internalize the system (navy/violet/cyan theme, glass `.card`, `grad-text`, `hero-aura`, `AmbientField`, `.eyebrow`, `Section`/`SectionTitle` primitives, spacing rhythm, tone). Then audit the OTHER marketing pages under `app/(marketing)/` — especially: about, contact, features, compare, matrix, business-email, domains, game-servers, block-storage, nxcloud, developers, migrate, affiliate, docs, and the many SEO landing pages (minecraft-server-hosting, cheap-vps-hosting, *-alternative, etc.). Also the shared `MarketingHeader`/`MarketingFooter`.

For each page/section, catalog INCONSISTENCIES vs the gold standard: off-theme colors, one-off components instead of shared primitives, mismatched hero/section styling, spacing/typography drift, outdated copy/claims, broken or dated layouts, anything that reads as a different website. Group findings by page, and give each a severity (how jarring) + a concrete "make it match by …" note. Also list which pages are ALREADY consistent (leave alone) and identify the shared primitives that, if applied, would fix the most pages at once.

Deliverable: a prioritized punch-list I can execute in waves — which pages need the most work, the common fixes, and the reusable components to standardize on. Be specific with file paths.

I have everything needed. Both governing templates and the bulk of pages are on-system; the drift is concentrated. Here is the consolidated audit.

---

# Nxeon marketing site — design-consistency audit & punch-list

**Gold standard** = `app/page.tsx` + `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx` (+ `PricingExplorer.tsx`). The reuse layer they codify lives in three files everything else should be built from:
- `components/marketing/primitives.tsx` — `Section`, `PageHero`, `SectionTitle`, `Eyebrow`
- `components/marketing/sections.tsx` — `SectionHeading`, `FeatureCard`, `CtaBand`, `TrustBadges`
- `app/globals.css` — `.rail`, `.card`/`.card-hover`/`.lift`/`.glass`, `.eyebrow(-pill)`, `.grad-text`, `.hero-aura`, `tone-panel/deep/light`, `.btn-primary/secondary`

## Big-picture finding
The site is in far better shape than "built page-by-page" implies. **~33 of the ~56 pages are driven by three shared templates that are all fully on-theme**, so they inherit the gold standard automatically:
- `components/marketing/UseCaseLanding.tsx` → 12 pages (cheap-vps-hosting, free-vps, docker-hosting, n8n-hosting, nextcloud-hosting, nodejs-hosting, wordpress-vps-hosting, discord-bot-hosting, affordable-vps-hosting, best-value-vps, singapore-vps-hosting, vpn-server-hosting)
- `components/marketing/GameLandingPage.tsx` → 13 pages (all `*-server-hosting` except minecraft/rust, plus gaming-vps)
- `components/marketing/ComparePageLayout.tsx` → 8 pages (all `*-alternative`, vps-vs-digitalocean, vps-vs-hostinger)

**Leave those 33 alone** — they're consistent by construction. The remaining work is on the ~20 bespoke pages, and it clusters into a handful of repeated fixes.

## Already consistent (do not touch)
about, contact, docs, affiliate, security (exemplary), features, developers*, vps*, business-email, domains, block-storage, game-servers, compare*, minecraft-server-hosting, rust-server-hosting — plus all 33 template-driven pages and the shared `MarketingHeader`/`MarketingFooter`/`MarketingLayout` (all clean, on-theme).
(*= layout is consistent but has a content/claims issue listed below.)

---

## The 5 fixes that clear the most pages

**Common fix A — Parameterize `CtaBand` (fixes 3 pages + stops future drift).** `sections.tsx` `CtaBand` is hardcoded to one headline. Three pages hand-roll a byte-identical copy of its `rounded-3xl … bg-navy-850/70` shell + inline `rgba(59,130,246)/rgba(138,112,251)` radial gradient just to change the copy:
- `matrix/page.tsx:331-360`, `migrate/page.tsx:274-300`, `revsports/page.tsx:166-192`
Add optional `title`/`sub`/`primary`/`secondary` props to `CtaBand`, then replace all three blocks with `<CtaBand title=… />`. One primitive change, three pages fixed, no more forked gradient.

**Common fix B — Fix the two "different-author" pages: `web-hosting` and `nxcloud`.** These share one non-system fingerprint (clearly built by the same hand, off-template):
- Hand-rolled cards `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-850/60 p-6` instead of `.card` — wrong border opacity (`/0.08` vs `/0.06`), wrong surface (`navy-850/60` vs `navy-900/70`), and drops `.card`'s `backdrop-blur-md` + inset/drop shadow. (`web-hosting` L84/112/142; `nxcloud` L89/108-110/145)
- Broken `Reveal` stagger: `delay={0.05}` / `delay={i*0.05}` — `delay` is **milliseconds**, so these round to ~0ms and no stagger renders. Gold standard uses `i * 60`. (web-hosting L62-74/83/111/141; nxcloud L67-79/88/107/144)
- Default `Section size="md"` where every sibling product page uses `size="lg"`; and `SectionTitle` with no `eyebrow`.
- `nxcloud` L108-110 featured card uses one-off `border-brand-500/50 bg-brand-500/[0.06]` instead of the site's established `.card lift … glow-brand` "popular tier" pattern (see business-email L167, block-storage L137).
Fix: swap to `className="card"` (+ `card-hover`/`lift`), `delay={i*60}`, `size="lg"`, add eyebrows, adopt `glow-brand` for the featured tier. This is the single largest structural win.

**Common fix C — Replace inline `FeatureCard` reimplementations.** `compare/page.tsx:180-186` and `matrix/page.tsx` "why" grid hand-build the exact icon-tile markup (`bg-gradient-to-br from-accent-blue/20 to-brand-500/20 p-3 text-brand-300`) that `FeatureCard` already provides. Import and use `<FeatureCard>`.

**Common fix D — Purge fabricated stats (honesty + consistency).** The homepage deliberately stripped invented figures (its own comment, `app/page.tsx:40-54`); several pages still carry them:
- `vps/page.tsx:138-139` — `47s Median deploy time` + `99.9% Uptime SLA` (no SLA exists). Replace with the honest "Under 60s deploy"; drop the SLA stat.
- `compare/page.tsx:55,57` — `"~47s deploys … 99.9% SLA"` + `"self-healing NVMe"`, on a page whose own row (L124) promises "no invented numbers." Strike or substantiate.
- `developers/page.tsx:67` — sample API response `"region": "eu-central"`; the platform is Singapore-only everywhere else. Change to `singapore`. Also `/docs` CTAs (L99, L196) — per your notes the public `/docs` route was retired.
- `v2/page.tsx` — see below (the worst offender).

**Common fix E — Standardize on primitives, not one-offs.** The reusable components to funnel everything through: **`PageHero`** (heroes), **`Section`** (bands + rhythm), **`SectionTitle`** (headings), **`FeatureCard`** (icon cards), **`CtaBand`** (closing CTA, once parameterized), **`.card`** (all surfaces). Applying just these six removes essentially every structural finding below.

---

## Prioritized punch-list, in waves

### Wave 1 — HIGH (reads as a different site / false claims)
1. **`app/(marketing)/v2/page.tsx` — delete it, or rebuild on the system.** It's a `robots:{index:false}` superseded preview homepage that never shipped (the real redesign went to `/`). It wraps everything in off-theme `bg-[#05070f]` (not `bg-navy-950`), defines its own `Eyebrow` component instead of `.eyebrow`, skips `AmbientField`/`PageHero`, and carries the exact fabricated stats the live homepage removed (`99.99%` uptime, `90s` deploy, `30+ global regions`, `1,900+ builders` — L96-99, L70). It's a live URL that reads as a different product. Recommend **delete**; if kept, rebuild with `PageHero` + `Section` and real figures.
2. **Fabricated stats sweep** — Common fix D: vps (L138-139), compare (L55/57), developers eu-central (L67). 

### Wave 2 — MED (structural drift, one primitive each)
3. **web-hosting + nxcloud** rebuild on `.card`/`Section size="lg"`/`delay*60`/eyebrows/`glow-brand` — Common fix B.
4. **Parameterize `CtaBand`**, then convert matrix / migrate / revsports — Common fix A.
5. **compare L180-186 & matrix "why" grid** → `<FeatureCard>` — Common fix C.
6. **matrix hero L127-165** — ~35 lines re-implementing `PageHero`. Render `<PageHero … >` with the trust row as `children` and the `<ConsoleMatrix/>` visual immediately after.
7. **vibe-coding L289-291** — light-band cards use `border-black/10 bg-white/60` and bypass the dedicated `.tone-light .card` styling (globals.css:237). Switch to `className="card"`.
8. **tools/page.tsx:133** — real bug: `SectionTitle` has `eyebrow` and `title` set to the **same string**, so every category band prints its label twice. Give the eyebrow a distinct kicker (e.g. `eyebrow="Free tools"`).
9. **developers `/docs` CTAs** (L99, L196) — retired route; repoint or remove.

### Wave 3 — LOW (polish; optional)
- `developers/page.tsx:79-80` terminal window uses `bg-red-400/70` + `bg-amber-400/70` dots (amber is theme-reserved for ratings) — recolor to slate if strict; it's a conventional macOS idiom otherwise.
- `about` stat band mixes `StatCounter` with hand-rolled cells; `tools` stat numbers lack `grad-text` that `about` uses — minor parity.
- `minecraft`/`rust` use icon-less `.card` "why" grids and a `<details>` FAQ accordion, while matrix/migrate render FAQ as a plain reveal list — the site has two FAQ patterns; pick one.
- `affiliate` has three near-identical CTA clusters (hero + mid-page L154-162 + CtaBand); drop the mid-page pair.
- `game-servers` `GAME_META` raw-hex gradients (L37-42) are per-game brand identity behind logos — intentional, leave.

### Deliberate, NOT drift (calibration notes for whoever executes)
- `emerald-400 ✓` checkmarks and "Live/In-browser" pills are site convention (used in `app/page.tsx:149` and `CtaBand` itself) — not a violation.
- Terminal/code-editor mockups on matrix/vibe-coding (macOS chrome dots `#ff5f57/#febc2e/#28c840`, Claude orange `#D97757`) and per-game logo gradients are intentional product visuals.

**Effort concentration:** Waves 1-2 (≈9 items, most sharing a primitive fix) bring every bespoke page in line. The highest ROI is Common fix B (web-hosting + nxcloud) and Common fix A (parameterize `CtaBand`) — together they resolve the bulk of the structural inconsistency, and deleting `v2` removes the one page that genuinely reads as a different website.
